text_block_list.text:
As I was working as usual, Super Creek 
happily placed a flyer on my desk.

The flyer reads: "1-Day Trial ☆ Pottery 
Workshop".

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Apparently, it's one of the events at the 
art museum. They say you can make your own 
rice bowls and teacups.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
"It looks fun, so Trainer, would you like 
to go together if you're free~?"

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I don't have any plans for today 
anyway, so let's head over right away♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-san, is there anything you'd like 
to make?
choice_data_list: Something you can use for training?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my. Fufu, I wonder if I can make 
something with pottery?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Your head is always full of thoughts about 
training, isn't it, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, seeing you work so hard and stay 
devoted to one thing is truly wonderful.
choice_data_list: What is Creek going to make?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Hrmmm, tough choice. A teacup or a vase 
would be nice, but...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
"If you don't carefully consider the 
thickness when crafting teacups, they seem 
to turn out heavy and hard to use..."

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Since vases are quite large... if we don't 
take our time and craft it carefully, it 
might end in failure.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Trainer, which one do you think is better?
choice_data_list: Maybe a vase that would make nice decor?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Well then, let's go with the teacup~.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Fufu. I hope it turns out well♪

I tried pottery making with Super Creek. 
Since we couldn't think of anything useful 
for training, we ended up making teacups 
together.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Phew... Good work today, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Intuition is important, but it takes much 
more thought than I expected.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Besides, if we take things too easy, it 
might not turn out right...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
“Still, once it started taking shape bit 
by bit, it felt almost like my own child—”

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I've grown so very fond of it.
choice_data_list:
I'm excited to see how it turns out once 
it's cooked.

Looking forward to seeing it all cooked 
and finished, right?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Yes♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Um, Trainer... Once our teacups are 
finished, would you like to trade with me?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
"Actually, that teacup... I made it while 
making a wish."

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
So you can enjoy some delicious tea and 
take a nice, relaxing breather.
choice_data_list: Is that what you were thinking?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I just wanted to soothe you a little, 
Trainer, since you're always working so 
hard...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
"Of course, I'll provide you with plenty 
of soothing comfort beyond just tea... 
Hehe."

Later on, Super Creek and I exchanged our 
finished teacups and enjoyed a relaxing 
tea together.

After her pottery-making experience, Super 
Creek seemed to have learned something 
truly important.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
It looks difficult, but taking on the 
challenge is valuable experience too.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Let's do our best♪

I tried pottery making with Super Creek. 
Since we couldn't think of anything useful 
for training, we ended up making a vase 
together.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for your hard work, Trainer. How 
did it go making it~?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Yes, really. It was cute seeing you so 
serious, Trainer...♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
“Still, that was much more delicate and 
required far more patience than I 
expected~.”

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Just gently resting your hands on it 
wasn't enough; it was surprisingly 
profound.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: It was a truly valuable experience.
choice_data_list:
I'm looking forward to when it's done 
baking.

Looking forward to when it's done baking, 
huh?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Once it's finished, let's go look for 
flowers to put in the vase together.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
We'll decorate our rooms—Trainer's and 
mine—with the exact same flowers.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Whenever you look at it, it'll remind you 
of today and surely put you in a happy 
mood♪

Later on, Super Creek and I went out to 
look for flowers to put in our finished 
vase.

After her pottery-making experience, Super 
Creek seemed to have learned something 
truly important.
